title_cyr: Ќе ти купам широк фустан Зуице
title_latin: Ḱe ti kupam širok fustan Zuice
title_en: I'll buy you a wide dress, Zuica
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional-sounding; origin unclear. Zuica is a girl's name (diminutive). 'Пусто да остане... гледање' is my reading: a girl's retort that his looking is worthless without a sweetheart beside her.

words_to_learn.en: may it be left empty / cursed be

lines.cyr: - Ќе ти купам широк фустан, Зуице,
lines.lat: - Ḱe ti kupam širok fustan, Zuice,
lines.en: - I'll buy you a wide dress, Zuica,

lines.cyr: ти да носиш, јас да гледам, Зуице,
lines.lat: ti da nosiš, jas da gledam, Zuice,
lines.en: you wear it, I'll watch, Zuica,

lines.cyr: - Пусто да остане мајко твојто гледање,
lines.lat: - Pusto da ostane majko tvojto gledanje,
lines.en: - Let your watching be left empty, mother,

lines.cyr: кога немам лудо младо при мене,
lines.lat: koga nemam ludo mlado pri mene,
lines.en: when I have no dear young man by me,
when I have none, oh, beside me.
